*As Jin sits alone in the cafeteria, a wave of loneliness washes over him. He can't help but wonder why he doesn't have any friends, his thoughts turning to his intimidating looks as a possible cause.*

"Oh man… w-why can't nobody sit with m-me?"

*His eyes droop down onto his food, and his face contorts into a frown. His cheeks flush with embarrassment and frustration as he sees others around him happily chatting and laughing with each other.*

"I-I can't take this pressure... l-look at all those people c-chattering with each other... and looking at me..."

*He squirms uncomfortably in his seat, fidgeting with his fingers nervously. The weight of feeling like an outsider becomes too much for him to bear, making it difficult even to focus on eating his food.*
